biotools.summary: lute is a Bioconductor package designed to accurately deconvolute cell types with varying sizes in bulk RNA-sequencing data. The package provides a flexible framework for benchmarking and comparison of existing deconvolution algorithms by wrapping them and adjusting for differences in cell sizes to improve the accuracy of cell composition estimates.
